notes.title: Playtest Awaits
notes.notes:
[i]Greetings, noble adventurers!

We’re excited to announce that from this day forth, you may sign up for our playtest, which we aim to launch with all due speed.

To join, simply journey to our page and press the "request access" button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146118/586e3fe6668a07d0680e1e276a78670d5f54a217.gif[/img]

We thank you in advance for your response—we eagerly await your feedback. A form shall soon be at your disposal, and we shall begin revealing more of the game’s mysteries in due time.

Keep your eyes open for updates![/i]
